acceptance: Reproduce whether the oracle judges unchanged files and whether out-of-diff findings should fail the gate, and why the Dispute comment run was skipped. Fix or document, with a test.
description: PR #3883 (SingleStore write_primitives merge ops, head 39a11334ed) got a failure verdict whose one Medium finding concerned ddl_alter_table_rename_column, which that PR does not modify (it landed in #3851). The author replied with a comment starting "Dispute:"; the issue_comment-triggered oracle-verdict and oracle-gate runs completed as skipped, and oracle-gate stayed failure until a "/oracle-review" comment was posted. The PR was closed before the outcome was observed.
